name: White River Otter
summary: An uncommon white-furred river otter that DayOne lists among the animals you can hunt in the wetlands.
body: DayOne's hunting guide (November 18, 2026) lists the White River Otter among the game's huntable animals, gives its habitat as wetland and recommends the Wortham W-22 for it.

DayOne describes it as an uncommon white-furred form of the North American river otter, found along Leonida's waterways and wetlands, and counts it among the rare and uncommon animals its writers had found so far.
Only DayOne names this white form; the app's Otter entry covers otters in general.

facts.menu_text: An uncommon, white-furred variant of the North American river otter found in Leonida's wetlands and near its rivers. A gentle kill will preserve the quality of the carcass.

name: Mottled Duck
summary: A wetland duck that DayOne lists as huntable; the rarer Mosaic Mottled Duck is a colour form of it.
body: DayOne's hunting guide (November 18, 2026) lists the Mottled Duck as a huntable wetland animal and recommends the Wortham W-22 for it.
DayOne describes the Mosaic Mottled Duck, which the app already has, as a rare colour form of the mottled duck found around fresh water in the wetlands.
GTA Tracker's wildlife database (updated November 18, 2026) also lists the Mottled Duck as a wetland dabbling duck, marked as seen in the game.
The Tampa Bay Times' reporters also found mottled ducks in the Grassrivers swamps while birding in the game on launch day.

facts.menu_text: Commonly seen on bodies of fresh water around Leonida, the mottled duck can be identified by the shiny blue patch on each of its wings, and is easily taken down by a low-power rifle.

name: Pit Bull
summary: A pit bull in a spiked gold collar appears beside a San4San member in one of Rockstar's official launch screenshots.
body: GTA Tracker's wildlife database lists the pit bull as an urban dog and says it appears with a San4San member, wearing a spiked gold collar, in one of Rockstar's official launch screenshots of Vice City.
TechWiser's animal list (November 19, 2026) also includes the Pit Bull among the game's land animals.
Neither page says what players can do with pit bulls in the game.
